name: Light Punch
detail: A fast punch, useful for quick checks and pressure.

name: Light Kick
detail: A fast kick. Range and cancel options vary by character.

name: Medium Punch
detail: A medium-strength punch often used in pressure, spacing, and combos.

name: Medium Kick
detail: A medium-strength kick useful for poking and controlling space.

name: Heavy Punch
detail: A stronger punch, often with greater startup or recovery.

name: Heavy Kick
detail: A stronger kick, often with more reach or damage but slower recovery.

name: Drive Impact
detail: In Classic controls, press Heavy Punch and Heavy Kick together. Costs one Drive bar.

name: Drive Parry
detail: In Classic controls, hold Medium Punch and Medium Kick together. Uses Drive Gauge.
